summary: Tested the CRM MOD work as the Pulse operator CRM user craig.henshall (role=manager). Areas: (1) MOD site companies link themselves to their portal org automatically, (2) Equipment register merged with portal equipment; text-only locations show as 'virtual' groups with 'Save as location'; Add location; Move to… with history kept, (3) Add Contact: job-title dropdown from the picklist, error text, required-field hint, duplicate-email message, (4) the new MOD Contracts tab (catalog A/B/C/repair/refurb, lines per location, CRUD, validation). Backend: 14/14 pass, 1 skip (no unlinked company found). Frontend: every flow tested on the MOD Test Site works end to end. All test data was cleaned up (TEST_ locations, contacts, contracts). The MOD Test Site pulley was moved and then put back in Fitness Suite.

minor.issue: No role check. Any CRM user can create locations (sites docs) in the linked MOD org, but the move endpoint and MOD contract edits need a manager or above. Use the same _require_editor gate.

MOD contracts (contract_type='mod') also come back from the generic contracts list and Live-compliance feed. The UI shows them under Contracts with 'No service schedule / No billing schedule / Sicon: Not synced' and '— · expires —'. This may be intended, but confirm. If not, filter them out with contract_type != 'mod', or map start_date/end_date/annual_value to the generic fields.
totals.sites counts virtual text locations and the 'Unassigned' bucket, so the MOD Test Site shows SITES 4 with only 2 real locations.

issues: There is no way to rename or delete a location once added. A typo means a permanent location.
The Email label has no '*' even though it is now required. First Name has one.
Delete uses window.confirm, which is inconsistent with the app's modals. Delete and load errors are not shown (delete has no try/catch).

action_items: Add a manager role gate to POST /crm/v2/companies/{id}/locations
Decide whether MOD contracts should appear in the generic Contracts list and Live compliance. Filter them out or map their fields
Exclude virtual and unassigned buckets from totals.sites (optional)
Wrap ModContractsTab.remove in try/catch and show the error
Optional: location rename/delete UI; '*' on the Email label
critical_code_review_comments: crm_mod_contracts.py: routes accept raw dict, not Pydantic models. Validation is manual but thorough (service type, price, location belongs to the org, status).
move_company_equipment: issues.update_many({equipment_id}) has no org filter. It is safe because equipment ids are UUIDs, but add organization_id as defence in depth.
CRMCompanies.js is ~2630 lines. It should be split (SitesAndEquipmentTab and the contact dialog are good candidates).
test_credentials: craig.henshall@pulsefitness.com / PulseMOD123! (CRM login). Browser tests injected crm_token + crm_active_mode=business into localStorage. Because no main platform token was set, a 'Your session has expired' toast appears. This is a test-setup artifact, not a bug.
seed_data_creation: None kept. TEST_ locations, contacts and contracts were deleted.
